world.title: Slush turns Nashik highway stretch into accident zone, NHAI tells civic body to initiate corrective measures
world.desc: NHAI urges Nashik Municipal Corporation to stop loose soil from roadworks washing onto Nashik highway, causing slush, skids and two-wheeler accidents.
